newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA LEU CLOSES WEAKER AT 3,560/75.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA LEU CLOSES WEAKER AT 3,560/75.

text.p: 1700 GMT - Romania's leu ended Friday weaker at 3,560/75 to the dollar, down from 3,495/15 on Thursday, on a quiet interbank market struggling with hard currency shortages, traders said.
* Interbank operators said they were trying to get better deals by trading in other currencies, whose quotes offered better leu-dollar prices of up to 4,200.

* Some traders on the retail market tried earlier on Friday to push the leu towards the all-time low of 5,000 recorded at the weekend but that was a shortlived attempt and rates oscillated near 4,200 during the evening hours.
* Operators said the money market stayed stagnant and overliquid, with one-week prices near 44 percent.
* The leu's reference rate was 3,509 on Friday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
